item.title: Oakley Capital funds America’s Cup team
item.description: Oakley Capital, which acquired North Sails in 2014, with their support later extending to Quantum Sails, Doyle Sails, Southern Spars, and Future Fibres, now adds an America’s Cup team to its portfolio. item.title: Race for funding to enter America’s Cup
item.description: There are five official entries for the 38th America’s Cup, with a massive omission among the field field. Five countries are represented, and none of them are the United States of America. If no USA team participates, it will be the first time in the event’s 175-year history.
